    • getOrinRobotToCamera

      public Transform3d[] getOrinRobotToCamera()
      Camera mounts, robot frame (x fwd, y left, z up; negative pitch tilts up). Position from CAD. Pitch, and orin-right's yaw, solved from TXMAN1 logs (Q13: 1318 multi-tag frames); the right bracket is toed 5.5 deg forward, as limelight-right's solve also shows. The Jetson's mount estimate (Vision/Orin/<camera>/Mount/*) checks height, pitch and roll.

    • getSeedConfirmLoops

      public int getSeedConfirmLoops()
      Consecutive seeding frames in which the best Limelight must have seeded the pose from two or more tags, with its heading holding within seedConfirmSpreadDeg, before the seed counts as confirmed. About a second at Limelight frame rates. This counts frames, not loops: a loop with no new frame neither extends nor breaks the run.

    • getSeedConfirmSpreadDeg

      public double getSeedConfirmSpreadDeg()
      Peak-to-peak spread (degrees) the MegaTag1 heading may show across the confirmation run. Four-tag heading holds to about a degree; a two-tag run that wanders past this is the geometry noise this exists to wait out, and the run starts over.

    • getGrossHeadingErrorDeg

      public double getGrossHeadingErrorDeg()
      Gross heading correction while enabled. 10 deg sits above the 5 to 8 deg that one camera's mount error can show. A single two-tag frame can read 15 deg off, so every multi-tag frame across the hold must be past the threshold.

    • getBackHeadingErrorDeg

      public double getBackHeadingErrorDeg()
      TXMAN1: the Pigeon drifted about 10 deg a match, under the gross threshold, and shots went 5-9 deg right. The median keeps one bad two-tag frame from setting the heading. 4 deg, not 2: in Playoff 19 replay a 2 deg trigger still made 7 corrections that alternated in sign (LL-Back MT1 carries a few degrees of position-dependent bias); 4 deg made 3, and still catches drift well before the 5-9 deg that cost shots.

    • getBackHeadingHoldSeconds

      public double getBackHeadingHoldSeconds()
      TXMAN1 Playoff 19 and 20: LL-Back MT1's heading scatters about 1.8 deg a frame (p90 3-4 deg), so a 3-frame median over 0.25 s crossed 2 deg on noise. It fired 33 and 19 times a match with alternating signs, each a 2-7 deg heading step and a Quest re-origin. A median of 8 or more frames over 1 s has about 0.8 deg of noise; drift of 10 deg a match still shows within the second.
